stills.prompt: Extreme close-up of the screen of an old ambulance patient monitor at night, the screen filling the whole frame. Black glass with a faint dark grid. One bright green heartbeat trace runs across the middle from the left edge: two sharp spikes, then the line runs dead flat and level to the right edge. The green phosphor glows and bleeds softly into the black. A faint reflection of blue emergency light on the glass. Shot on 35 mm film, real grain, slightly soft focus. No numbers, no letters, no text and no logos anywhere on the screen.

stills.why: LS20 failed; a fresh still of the same moment from inside
stills.prompt: Inside the back of a UK ambulance racing through the city at night, seen from the bench seat at the rear with the back doors shut. Two paramedics in dark green uniforms, surgical masks and blue gloves lean over a man on the stretcher; one presses on his chest, the other reaches for the heart monitor on the wall, its green trace racing. Hard cold strip lights overhead, blue emergency light flickering through the small cab window ahead. The compartment sways; slight motion blur on their hands. Real 35 mm night film photograph, grainy, a little underexposed, handheld.

clip.motion: The camera does not move. The screen of an ambulance heart monitor at night. A bright green heartbeat trace sweeps from left to right across the black screen, drawing two last sharp heartbeats, then the line goes completely flat and keeps sweeping, dead level, to the right edge. The green glow flickers faintly. Nothing else on the screen changes. No numbers, no text, no logos, no people. The camera does not move.
